reauth_confirm.title: Repair AGL sign-in
reauth_confirm.description:
Home Assistant could not refresh this entry's AGL sign-in: AGL rejected the stored token (it expired, was revoked, or a rotation failed to save). Logging in again repairs the entry; your energy history is kept.

This keeps the certificate fingerprints already pinned for this entry. If Haggle reported that an AGL certificate changed, use **Reconfigure** from the entry's menu instead -- that is the step that re-pins.

Open the URL below in your browser and log in with the AGL login that owns this entry's contract. After login you will see a 'Not Found' page -- copy the full URL from the address bar and paste it in the field below.

`{authorize_url}`

data.callback_url: Callback URL (from address bar after login)

reconfigure.title: Re-pin AGL certificates
reconfigure.description:
Use this after Haggle reports that an AGL certificate changed. Logging in again refreshes this entry's AGL sign-in and re-captures the certificate fingerprints your Home Assistant host sees for secure.agl.com.au and api.platform.agl.com.au.

**Only continue on a network you trust.** Re-pinning trusts whatever certificate reaches your Home Assistant host right now. If anything between Home Assistant and AGL is intercepting TLS (a corporate proxy, a security appliance or an attacker), its certificate becomes the trusted one and the warning stops.

Open the URL below in your browser and log in with the AGL login that owns this entry's contract. After login you will see a 'Not Found' page -- copy the full URL from the address bar and paste it in the field below.

`{authorize_url}`

data.callback_url: Callback URL (from address bar after login)

select_contract.title: Choose AGL contract
select_contract.description: Select the electricity contract to monitor. If an error is shown, submit to try again.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed or callback URL is invalid. Try opening the authorize URL again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach AGL. Check your internet connection.

abort.already_configured: This AGL contract is already configured.
abort.no_electricity_contract: No electricity contract found on this AGL account. Haggle reads AGL's smart-meter electricity data; gas contracts are not supported.
abort.reconfigure_successful: AGL sign-in refreshed and certificate fingerprints re-pinned. Haggle is reloading.
abort.reconfigure_pin_incomplete: AGL sign-in refreshed, but the certificate could not be captured for one or both AGL hosts. The stored fingerprint for that host was kept and its warning remains. Haggle is reloading -- try Reconfigure again to finish re-pinning.
abort.contract_not_found: The AGL login you used does not include the contract this entry monitors (or that contract now belongs to a different AGL account). Nothing was changed. Log in with the AGL login that owns it; if the contract has closed or moved, remove this entry and add the integration again -- your existing statistics are kept.
abort.entry_not_repairable: This entry was created without a contract number and cannot be repaired in place. Remove it and add the integration again -- your existing statistics are kept.

solar_heal_gave_up.title: Solar history backfill gave up
solar_heal_gave_up.description: For entry {entry}: Haggle tried {attempts} times to backfill older solar history (back to {floor}), but AGL kept returning errors for at least one day, and has stopped retrying. The days that could not be fetched are permanently missing from the solar statistics. If those days matter to you, check whether the AGL app shows data for the same dates, then see the diagnostics guide (Learn more) for recovery options.

solar_repair_gave_up.title: Solar statistics repair gave up
solar_repair_gave_up.description: For entry {entry}: Haggle detected a downward step in the cumulative solar statistics and tried {attempts} times to rebuild the series (back to {floor}), but could not complete a clean sweep. A downward step may persist in the solar statistics. It can be corrected manually via Developer Tools → Statistics — see the diagnostics guide (Learn more).

solar_stall_gave_up.title: Solar backfill skipped {start} to {end}
solar_stall_gave_up.description: For entry {entry}: AGL returned errors for every day in {start}..{end} for {cycles} consecutive polls, so Haggle marked the span as covered and moved on. These days are recorded as zero export and will not be retried automatically — a permanent gap in the solar statistics. If the AGL app shows data for these dates, see the diagnostics guide (Learn more) for recovery options.

data_description.solar_statistics_enabled: Turn off to freeze all solar statistics writes (backfill, self-heal, give-up markers) without uninstalling or downgrading. Existing statistics are untouched; the bill-period solar sensors read 'unknown' while disabled and the cumulative sensors keep their last stored values. Takes effect from the next poll. Consumption statistics are unaffected.
data_description.poll_interval_hours: How often to check AGL for new data. AGL's own feed lags 24-48h behind real-time, so anything below 24h has nothing new to find -- the integration enforces a 24h floor. Raise this if you want to reduce request volume. Takes effect from the next poll.
